title: 第17章 手刃袁氏父子
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
茶州城，刺史府，灯火通明。

    书房。

    茶州别驾躬身入内，将账簿轻放案前，低声禀道：“大人，这月的‘孝敬’比上月多了三成。”

    袁成头也不抬，将手边一碗参汤一饮而尽，语气淡漠：“还是少了。”

    别驾脊背一僵，冷汗微流，愈发恭敬：“请大人指示。”

    “那流云商会不是仗着攀附了云王，以为有了靠山？”袁成抬起眸子：“让他们这月再上缴一成利银。”

    他神情带着一丝嘲弄，淡淡道：“本官那座园子，还差个湖心亭！”

    流云商会与陆舟的事，自然逃不过他的眼睛。

    不过那位云王嘛……估计已是自身难保。

    想到这，袁成的眼神透着一丝狠意。

    谁都别想动老夫的独子！

    他要让其他人看看，到底谁才是这茶州城的天！

    “下官遵命！”云州别驾躬身离去。

    人刚走远，书房门便被人一把推开。

    袁决带着满脸怨气闯了进来，开头就是一句抱怨：“父亲，听春楼的姑娘都不好玩！”

    袁成本来垂眸看着桌案上的账目，听见儿子的声音，方才冷硬的老脸瞬间绽放出笑容。

    他立刻放下手中文书，起身哄着他坐下，好声好气道：“无妨，无妨。为父又弄来了一批罪属家眷，里头有几个模样不错的，回头让老周挑好的送到你房里去。”

    袁决却怨念不散，嘴里嘟囔着：“父亲昨日不是说，要把那天那个女人弄给我嘛。”

    他说的是那个被陆舟救走的柳仙儿。

    那日街上一见，他便念念不忘。

    当然，最重要的是，那天也是他袁大公子头一回在全城百姓面前被人踩在脚下，丢尽了脸面。

    这笔账，他一定要讨回来。

    “放心，为父已派人去了！”袁成挺了挺胸膛，抚须一笑：“到时候，别说那个女人了，那日之耻，为父也一并替你讨回来！”

    “真的？”袁决眼睛一亮，怨气消散了大半。

    他馋那个女人，更恨踩他的陆舟。

    这两桩心事，父亲若能一并替他解决，那他可太高兴了。

    袁成微微颔首，自信满满道：“自然。”

    闻言，袁决也是开心了起来，正要再说些什么，忽然想起刚才在门外听到的只言片语。

    他便凑近了些，笑嘻嘻地问道：“对了父亲，我刚才听说您要对流云商会下手？”
content_en:
Chazhou City, the Governor's Mansion, is brightly lit.

    study.

    Chazhou Biejia bowed his head and entered, gently placed the account book in front of the case, and said in a low voice: "Sir, the number of 'filial piety' this month is 30% more than last month."

    Without raising his head, Yuan Cheng drank the bowl of ginseng soup at hand and said indifferently: "It's still missing."

    Biejiu's back stiffened, cold sweat flowed slightly, and he became more respectful: "Please give me instructions, sir."

    "Then the Liuyun Chamber of Commerce didn't rely on clinging to King Yun, thinking they had a backer?" Yuan Cheng raised his eyes: "Let them turn over another 10% of the silver this month."

    With a hint of mockery in his expression, he said calmly: "My garden still needs a pavilion in the middle of the lake!"

    Naturally, the matter between Liuyun Chamber of Commerce and Lu Zhou could not escape his eyes.

    But that King Yun... probably couldn't protect himself.

    Thinking of this, Yuan Cheng's eyes revealed a trace of cruelty.

    No one can touch my only son!

    He wants others to see who is the leader of this Chazhou City!

    "I obey your orders!" Yunzhou bowed and left.

    As soon as the person walked away, the study door was pushed open.

    Yuan Jue burst in with a face full of resentment, starting with a complaint: "Father, the girls in Tingchun Tower are not fun!"

    Yuan Chenglai lowered his eyes and looked at the accounts on the table. When he heard his son's voice, his cold old face suddenly burst into a smile.

    He immediately put down the documents in his hand, stood up and coaxed him to sit down, and said in a good voice: "It doesn't matter, it doesn't matter. I got another batch of criminal family members for my father, and there are a few good-looking ones among them. I will ask Lao Zhou to pick them up and send them to your room."

    However, Yuan Jue was still resentful and muttered: "Didn't my father say yesterday that he would give me that woman that day?"

    He was talking about Liu Xian'er who was rescued by Lu Zhou.

    As soon as he saw it on the street that day, he would never forget it.

    Of course, the most important thing is that that day was also the first time that Young Master Yuan was trampled under his feet in front of the people in the city and was completely humiliated.

    He must get this debt back.

    "Don't worry, my father has sent someone!" Yuan Cheng puffed out his chest and smiled: "When the time comes, let alone that woman, I will take back the shame of that day for you!"

    "Really?" Yuan Jue's eyes lit up, and most of his resentment dissipated.

    He coveted that woman, and even more hated Lu Zhou for stepping on him.

    If his father could solve these two worries for him, he would be very happy.

    Yuan Cheng nodded slightly and said confidently: "Naturally."

    Hearing this, Yuan Jue also became happy. Just as he was about to say something more, he suddenly remembered the few words he heard outside the door just now.

    He came closer and asked with a smile: "By the way, father, I just heard that you are going to attack the Liuyun Chamber of Commerce?"
title_en: Chapter 17: Killing Yuan and his son by hand
